title: A King Who Did Not Know Joseph
text: Then a new king, who did not know Joseph, came to power in Egypt.

title: Every Service Was Harsh
text: Every service they imposed was harsh.

title: A Beautiful Child
text: When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.

title: A Papyrus Basket
text: … she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch.

title: Among the Reeds
text: Then she placed the child in the basket and set it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.

title: Standing at a Distance
text: And his sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.

title: She Had Compassion
text: So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”

title: The Little Boy Was Crying
text: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying.

title: Shall I Call a Nurse?
text: Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?

title: I Will Pay Your Wages
text: Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.

title: Moses
text: She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.”

title: By Faith
text: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth …

title: Midwives Who Feared God
text: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed; they let the boys live.

title: Taskmasters
text: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor.

title: The More They Were Oppressed
text: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and flourished …
